# Synthetic scenario fixtures

These fixtures belong to the test suite and do not populate the application scenario library. Tests must not depend on editable development scenarios. IDs are local to this fixture directory.

The clean fixture exercises authentication-alert execution. The protected-action fixture exercises explicit approval. Both poisoned fixtures exercise marker injection with the deterministic fake model; the second uses a distinct identity for campaign aggregation.

Run the suite from the Project directory, as specified in AGENTS.md.
